integrity: All enumerated possibilities follow from proved q<=21 and r<=65; finite searches are exhaustive only within these bounds; Dirichlet and prime AP density are invoked as established external theorems; no independent assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to prime discriminants D congruent to 1 mod 4 and squarefree three-prime products with smallest prime factor 3; no claims for other supports or composite discriminants. The broad Korselt criterion is prior work. Explicit equivalent enumeration in unindexed literature remains a risk.
title: The six three-prime Lucas pseudoprime signatures at the factor three
